exposure: Integrated Child Development Services beneficiary status
cohort: The study included 420 children aged 6-59 months residing in a rural village of Chengalpattu district, India.
finding: The overall rate of malnutrition was 46.2% (30.2% stunted, 21% wasted, and 24.3% underweight), indicating that undernutrition remains a significant health concern among children under 5 years of age in the studied rural area.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was statistically significantly associated with malnutrition.
cross-section timing: At a single point in time
